note: Houses the enumerator wrote down as standing empty on census night. A house here is NOT a gap in the record - it is an answer, and the gap tools should stop offering it. Every one is taken from the 'Uninhabited' column of the enumerator's page, which is why the round and the property are both fixed. Loaded into census_unoccupied by tools_load_unoccupied.py.
